task: Immutable middleware Pipeline with Router, auth/recover/trace/TTL-cache middlewares
reasoning_summary: Modelled the chain of responsibility as an immutable Pipeline that folds middlewares into nested Handlers, with the first-used middleware outermost. Router and middlewares are small immutable/stateless units with an injected Clock for the TTL cache. Two tests initially failed because I wrote them with the wrong middleware order; I fixed the tests, not the code.
